declarations.title: Workbench notebook terminal access is disabled
declarations.description: Checks whether Workbench v2 metadata disables the JupyterLab terminal. Notebook code execution and effective operating-system isolation are outside this configuration check.
declarations.pass_when: The exact metadata key is the documented string true.
declarations.fail_when: The metadata key is false or absent in a full native representation.
declarations.unknown_when: Native collection, scope, state, representation or setting is denied, partial, redacted or malformed; schedule syntax outside the supported subset remains UNKNOWN.
declarations.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
declarations.remediation: Set notebook-disable-terminal to true in Workbench instance metadata. Keep notebook service-account permissions limited to the workload.
remediation_steps: Set notebook-disable-terminal to true in Workbench instance metadata.
Keep notebook service-account permissions limited to the workload.

declarations.title: Workbench JupyterLab file downloads are disabled
declarations.description: Checks whether Workbench v2 metadata disables downloads through JupyterLab. Other data-transfer paths and effective data-loss prevention are outside this configuration check.
declarations.pass_when: The exact metadata key is the documented string true.
declarations.fail_when: The metadata key is false or absent in a full native representation.
declarations.unknown_when: Native collection, scope, state, representation or setting is denied, partial, redacted or malformed; schedule syntax outside the supported subset remains UNKNOWN.
declarations.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
declarations.remediation: Set notebook-disable-downloads to true in Workbench instance metadata. Use governed storage when sharing notebook results.

declarations.title: Workbench automatic upgrade schedule is declared
declarations.description: Checks the Workbench v2 upgrade-schedule metadata declaration against a bounded supported cron format. A schedule does not establish upgrade execution, cadence adequacy or current patch status.
declarations.pass_when: A supported nonempty five-field cron schedule is declared.
declarations.fail_when: The schedule is absent in a full native representation or is explicitly empty.
declarations.unknown_when: Native collection, scope, state, representation or setting is denied, partial, redacted or malformed; schedule syntax outside the supported subset remains UNKNOWN.
declarations.not_applicable_when: A fully bound native Workbench instance has state DELETED.
declarations.remediation: Set a supported five-field GMT upgrade schedule in Workbench instance metadata. Review upgrade eligibility and completion separately.
remediation_steps: Set a supported five-field GMT upgrade schedule in Workbench instance metadata.
Review upgrade eligibility and completion separately.
